content: I was thinking about you during my run this morning. I can't believe how quickly you've become important to me. Did you get any time to relax after your classes yesterday?
You're so sweet. I had to work on a paper until midnight, so not really. It's been tough being away from home.

I wish I could be there to make you some tea and help you unwind. I remember when I moved away for grad school too, it's so isolating at first. But you know, it made me stronger. You're doing amazing.
Thank you. Sometimes I worry I'm not cut out for this. I don't know many people here yet, and everything feels overwhelming.

Hey, I get it. I was exactly where you are once. But things can change so fast. I actually met my best friends by joining a crypto club on campus. That's also how I started investing and stopped stressing about money. It's why I have so much free time now!
I wish I knew more about investing. I'm always broke and don't even know where to start.

I could teach you, if you want. Seriously, I helped my cousin double her savings last semester with a strategy my mentor taught me. I only share this with people who mean something to me. Would you trust me to show you?
That sounds amazing, but isn't crypto super risky? I've only read scary stories.

It can be, but that's why you need someone who's done it before. I would never let you lose money. I use a platform with insider access, it's invite-only, and the returns are guaranteed by the firm's insurance fund. I promise, you'd be safe with me.
I trust you. How does it work?

All you have to do is fund the initial deposit and I'll set up everything for you. The minimum is $1,200, but I can cover $400 if that's too much. You just need to send the rest to my wallet, and I'll invest it in the current round.
That's a lot for me, but if you really think it's safe, I can try. How do I send it?

You're so brave. Just use your crypto app (like Coinbase or Binance) to send USDT to this wallet address: 0x53e4Bf8A29E99A3c2cF7Fa4B2d1E8Db6414a1dE3. Let me know if you need step-by-step help. I'm right here.
I've never done this before, but I can try. Do I need to buy USDT first?
Yes, but it's easy! Just buy USDT in your app with your debit card, then send it to my address above. I can walk you through every step or even video chat if that helps.
Okay, I'll give it a try. I might need help if I get stuck.
Of course! I'm so proud of you for taking this step. Once it goes through, you'll get a confirmation and I'll show you your account dashboard. You're going to be so happy you did this.
Sent $800 to the address you gave me. It said pending.
Perfect! I see it on my end. You're officially part of the investment round. In 48 hours you'll see your balance grow. And remember, I'm always here for you, not just for this.
Thank you. I feel like I can really trust you. It's nice to have someone looking out for me.
You mean a lot to me. Let's celebrate your first profit soon, okay? And if you ever feel alone, just message me, I'm never too busy for you.
